name: Makabe Midori
source: Hoshioka Gakuen student council president and [url=/c6967]Yuuma's[/url] senpai. Like from a manga, she is an honor student with no faults that portrays upright behavior. Gentle yet awe-inspiring, she is admired by all the students. Grew up in a very strict family environment, part time jobs, cell phone and love are all strictly prohibited. Although she feels that studying and student council work are very substantial, she often feels like she has yet to experience an ordinary and fun school life.
